newsitem.title: UK: Racal wins 9 mln stg Heathrow Express deal.
newsitem.headline: Racal wins 9 mln stg Heathrow Express deal.

text.p: Electronics and communications group Racal Electronics Plc said on Monday its unit Racal-BRT won contracts worth over 9.0 million stg to provide signalling and radio communications for the Heathrow Express rail link.
The Heathrow Express, owned by airport operator BAA Plc, will run from London's Paddington station to Heathrow airport and is expected to start services in June 1998.

Racal Electronics Plc bought Racal-BRT, a former subsidiary of the British Railways Board, in December 1995 as part of the government's privatisation programme. The unit manages and operates a telecommunications network for railways in Britain.
